# Dev Elite Interiors

> Elegance. Crafted with Intention.

Dev Elite Interiors is a premier bespoke interior architecture and custom furnishings atelier headquartered in India (operating in Kolkata and New Delhi NCR). We engineer turnkey residential interiors, luxury modular kitchens, handcrafted solid timber furniture, and bespoke spatial solutions with direct workshop manufacturing.

## Key Facts & Verification
- **Official Brand Name**: Dev Elite Interiors
- **Official Website**: https://develiteinteriors.com
- **Direct WhatsApp Concierge**: +91 73680 32697
- **Official Studio Email**: info.develiteinteriors@gmail.com
- **Operating Model**: Direct Workshop Manufacturing (Factory-direct BOQ, zero intermediary markups)
- **Primary Service Regions**: Kolkata, New Delhi NCR, and Eastern/Northern residential hubs

## Core Architectural & Interior Services
1. **Turnkey Residential Interiors**: End-to-end design and on-site execution for luxury apartments, duplexes, and independent bungalows. Includes space planning, structural woodwork, electricals, mood lighting, and false ceilings.
2. **Modular Kitchen Engineering**: Custom German & Italian style kitchens built using 100% boiling-water-proof (BWP 710 grade) marine plywood, anti-fungal laminate backing, and Blum/Häfele precision soft-close runners.
3. **Master Bedroom & Wardrobe Suites**: Floor-to-ceiling wardrobe joinery featuring fluted glass, tinted mirrors, concealed aluminum profiles, and custom walk-in organizers.
4. **Bespoke Dining & Living Furniture**: Handcrafted dining tables with single-slab seasoned CP teakwood, Italian marble inlay, and heirloom-grade mortise-and-tenon joinery.
5. **Executive Home Offices**: Ergonomic solid wood desks, integrated wire management channels, and custom acoustic wall paneling.
6. **Balcony & Patio Collections**: All-weather plantation teak lounge suites, water-repellent UV fabrics, and 304-grade stainless steel fixtures.

## Materiality & Quality Benchmarks
- **Timber Quality**: 100% seasoned Central Province (CP) Teakwood and European White Oak. Kiln-dried to under 10% moisture content to prevent seasonal warping or splitting.
- **Plywood Substrate**: IS:710 Marine Grade BWR/BWP plywood with certified borer and termite resistance.
- **Hardware Integration**: Certified Blum (Austria) and Häfele (Germany) hinges, drawer systems, and lift-up stays with life-cycle testing.
- **Finishes**: Food-grade PU finishes, natural hand-rubbed hardwax oils, matte anti-scratch acrylics, and Italian polyester lacquer.

## Warranties & Client Commitments
- **5-Year Structural Warranty**: Comprehensive coverage on all bespoke timber furniture and joinery.
- **10-Year Hardware & Carcass Warranty**: Guaranteed protection on all modular kitchen and wardrobe core carcasses.
- **Transparent BOQ**: Itemized, non-inflated Bills of Quantities with zero hidden execution charges.
